use_cases.name: Raise a requisition with position control check
use_cases.goal: Raise a requisition that is either a replacement against a vacated position or an addition within sanctioned headroom, with any override recorded.

stakeholders.interest: Approved manpower is enforced as a control, not a meeting figure.
Replacement hiring never double-counts headcount.
Overrides carry a recorded business reason.

use_cases.trigger: A vacancy arises or the business needs growth headcount.
preconditions: Sanctioned strength is set per org unit, designation and location.
Positions carry status and vacated_on dates.
Approval chain for requisitions is configured.
postconditions_success: Requisition is SUBMITTED, consuming headroom only if it is an addition.
Any override is stored with override_by, override_reason and an audit entry.
postconditions_failure: Requisition is BLOCKED with the headroom shown, or WITHDRAWN by the hiring manager.

main_flow.action: Raises a requisition giving org unit, designation, location and type: replacement or addition.
For a replacement, requires against_position_code of a vacant position and consumes no fresh sanctioned strength.
For an addition, computes headroom as sanctioned minus filled minus open and blocks at approval if headroom is zero.
Where the business demands it, an authorised role overrides the block with a recorded reason.

steps: Platform skips the position-code check and proceeds to the headroom check.

alternate_flows.condition: Addition has headroom of one or more.
steps: Platform submits the requisition into the approval chain and reserves one unit of headroom as open.

alternate_flows.condition: Replacement with a valid vacated position.
steps: Platform submits the requisition without the headroom check.

exception_flows.condition: Replacement names a position that is filled or does not exist.
exception_flows.handling: Submission is refused stating the position must be vacant.

exception_flows.condition: Addition finds no headroom, as at Machining in Peenya with 24 of 24 filled.
exception_flows.handling: Requisition moves to BLOCKED and talent.requisition.blocked is emitted with headroom and reason.

exception_flows.condition: Override attempted by a role without override rights or without a reason.
exception_flows.handling: Override is refused and the requisition stays BLOCKED.

nfrs: Headroom shown on the requisition form within 1 s of choosing org unit, designation and location.
Headroom computation is shared with the sanctioned strength board so both show the same figure.

user_stories.want: to raise a replacement against the vacated position code
user_stories.so_that: the department headcount is not double-counted

acceptance.given: position POS-2214 is vacant
acceptance.when: I raise REQ-2026-0037 as a replacement against POS-2214
acceptance.then: it is submitted and sanctioned headroom for the unit is unchanged

acceptance.given: I name a position that is currently filled
acceptance.then: submission is refused stating the position must be vacant

user_stories.want: additions beyond sanctioned strength stopped at approval
user_stories.so_that: approved manpower works as a control

acceptance.given: OU-111 at Peenya has 24 sanctioned and 24 filled
acceptance.when: REQ-2026-0041 is raised as an addition
acceptance.then: it moves to BLOCKED with headroom 0 shown and does not pass with a warning

acceptance.given: the same unit has 24 sanctioned, 22 filled and 1 open
acceptance.then: it is submitted and headroom shows 0 afterwards

user_stories.want: to override a sanction block with a recorded reason
user_stories.so_that: urgent business needs can proceed with accountability

acceptance.given: REQ-2026-0041 is BLOCKED
acceptance.when: I override with reason new customer line ramp-up
acceptance.then: it moves to SUBMITTED and the audit entry shows my identity and reason

acceptance.given: a hiring manager without override rights
acceptance.then: the action is refused

use_cases.name: Move candidates through the pipeline to offer
use_cases.goal: Progress candidates for an approved requisition through stages to an offer, with ranking assisting and humans deciding every disposition.

stakeholders.interest: Is assessed fairly and never auto-rejected by a machine.
Sees a ranked shortlist with reasons.
Every rejection carries a human decision and reason.

use_cases.trigger: A requisition is approved and open for sourcing.
preconditions: Requisition is APPROVED.
Pipeline stages are configured for the requisition type.
postconditions_success: Selected candidate has an accepted offer and the requisition proceeds toward FILLED on joining.
Every other candidate has a human disposition with reason.
postconditions_failure: Requisition remains open with candidates in their last stage.

main_flow.action: Opens the approved requisition and reviews applicants received from all sources.
Ranks applicants against requisition criteria and shows the evidence behind each ranking; it rejects no one.
Shortlists candidates and records a reason for each candidate not shortlisted.
Interviews shortlisted candidates and submits scorecards.
Selects the preferred candidate and records the decision reason.
Prepares the offer from the approved range and routes it for approval.
Accepts the offer; the platform hands the candidate to pre-boarding.

steps: Hiring manager selects the next candidate from the shortlist.

exception_flows.condition: Ranking agent proposes rejecting a candidate.
exception_flows.handling: Proposal is ignored as an action; only a human disposition can reject, and the proposal is recorded in the action ledger.

exception_flows.condition: Recruiter dispositions a candidate without a reason.
exception_flows.handling: Disposition cannot be saved until a reason is selected.

nfrs: Ranking explanation shown with every ranked candidate.
Disposition history is retained per candidate for the configured retention period.

user_stories.want: a ranked list with the reason for each rank
user_stories.so_that: I review the strongest fits first

acceptance.given: 60 applicants for a CNC operator requisition
acceptance.then: each candidate shows a rank and the matched and missing criteria

acceptance.given: the agent's ranking places a candidate last
acceptance.then: the candidate is still in Applied stage and not rejected

user_stories.want: to be rejected only by a person with a recorded reason

acceptance.given: my application is under review
acceptance.then: the rejection carries the recruiter's identity and a selected reason

acceptance.given: no human has acted on my application
acceptance.then: my application remains open and is not auto-rejected

use_cases.name: Track a referral and pay the award through payroll
use_cases.goal: Capture an employee referral against an open requisition and pay the award in parts on joining and confirmation through named payroll runs.

stakeholders.interest: Award is paid on time and in full, including the confirmation balance.
Award arrives as a payroll input, not a spreadsheet.
Referral source effectiveness is measurable.

preconditions: Referral programme with award amount and split is configured.
Requisition is open for sourcing.
postconditions_success: Joining part and confirmation balance are each raised as payroll inputs in named runs.
Referral stage and award status are visible to the referrer.
postconditions_failure: No payroll input is raised if the candidate does not join or is not confirmed.

main_flow.action: Submits a referral with candidate details against an open requisition on the referrals screen.
Matures the award as the candidate progresses: the joining part on joining and the balance on confirmation.
Raises each matured part as a referral award payroll input in a named run.

alternate_flows.condition: Candidate joins but leaves before confirmation.
steps: Joining part remains paid; the balance is cancelled with reason recorded.

exception_flows.condition: Candidate already exists in the pipeline from another source.
exception_flows.handling: Referral is recorded as duplicate and the referrer is told the candidate was already sourced.

exception_flows.condition: Named payroll run is finalised before the input is raised.
exception_flows.handling: Input moves to the next open run and the payroll manager is notified.

nfrs: Referral status updates within 5 minutes of a candidate stage change.

user_stories.want: to track my referral through stages and see when my award becomes payable
user_stories.so_that: I know what I will receive and when

acceptance.given: a programme paying 20,000 split 50% on joining and 50% on confirmation
acceptance.when: my referred candidate joins on 1 June
acceptance.then: 10,000 shows as matured and payable in the June run

acceptance.given: the candidate is confirmed on 1 December
acceptance.then: the balance of 10,000 matures and is raised in the December run

user_stories.want: referral awards to reach me as payroll inputs
user_stories.so_that: awards are paid and taxed like any other earning

acceptance.given: a matured joining part of 10,000
acceptance.then: a referral award input of 10,000 appears for the referrer

acceptance.given: the June run is finalised before maturity
acceptance.then: the input is raised in the July run and I am notified

use_cases.name: Set goals, hold check-ins and complete the review cycle
use_cases.goal: Run a quarterly cycle of goal setting, check-ins and review where AI may draft text but humans decide and sign.

stakeholders.interest: Has clear goals and a fair, signed review.
Spends less time drafting and more on conversation.
Can see which text was AI-drafted and who signed it.

preconditions: Cycle template and rating scale are configured.
Reporting lines are current.
postconditions_success: Goals, check-in notes and a signed review exist for each employee in the cycle.
Draft provenance is recorded for any AI-drafted text.
postconditions_failure: Unsigned reviews remain in draft and are excluded from calibration.

main_flow.action: Opens the cycle with dates for goal setting, check-ins and review.
Drafts goals with weights and submits them to the manager.
Agrees or edits goals and records agreement.
Holds check-ins during the quarter and records notes and progress.
Drafts a review summary from goals, progress and check-in notes, marked as AI draft.
Edits the draft, assigns the rating and signs the review.
Reads the review, adds comments and acknowledges it.
Records the signed review with the signer and the provenance of each section.

alternate_flows.condition: Manager chooses not to use the AI draft.
steps: Manager writes the review directly; no draft provenance is recorded.

exception_flows.condition: Manager attempts to sign the AI draft without any review action.
exception_flows.handling: Platform requires the manager to confirm each section before signing.

exception_flows.condition: Goal weights do not total 100%.
exception_flows.handling: Submission is blocked with the current total shown.

nfrs: AI drafts are generated within 10 s and stored with model provenance and the inputs used.

user_stories.want: an AI-drafted review summary I can edit before signing
user_stories.so_that: I write better reviews faster while remaining accountable

acceptance.given: an employee with four goals and three check-in notes
acceptance.then: a summary marked AI draft appears referencing each goal

acceptance.given: I edit two sections and sign
acceptance.then: the record shows me as signer and which sections were AI-drafted

user_stories.want: to acknowledge and comment on my signed review
user_stories.so_that: my view is part of the record

acceptance.given: my manager signs my review
acceptance.then: I can add comments and acknowledge

acceptance.given: I acknowledge
acceptance.then: my review shows acknowledged with the date

use_cases.name: Infer skills and assign learning paths

stakeholders.interest: Receives relevant learning with clear due dates.

main_flow.action: Receives a work signal or completion such as a course passed or a certification recorded.
Proposes skill updates with the evidence and a confidence level.
Confirms or rejects proposed skills above the tenant's confirmation threshold.
Stores confirmed skills and identifies gaps against the role's skill profile.
Assigns learning paths for the gaps using the standard assignment mechanism.
Sees assigned paths with due dates in My learning and starts them.
Records completion evidence, which feeds back as a new signal.

alternate_flows.condition: Trigger is the joining chain induction step.
steps: Platform assigns the induction path through the same mechanism without inference.

exception_flows.condition: Manager rejects a proposed skill.
exception_flows.handling: Skill is not stored and the rejection is recorded against the proposal.

exception_flows.condition: Employee already holds the path assignment.
exception_flows.handling: No duplicate assignment is created.

nfrs: Skill proposals carry evidence links for every inferred skill.

user_stories.want: assigned learning paths with due dates in one place
user_stories.so_that: I know what to complete and by when

use_cases.name: Manage candidates through a configurable applicant pipeline

main_flow.action: Applies and gives consent for processing personal data for this and, optionally, future roles.

Confirms or rejects the merge proposal.
Moves the candidate through stages such as screening, interview and offer.

postconditions_success: Interviews are scheduled and each panelist's scorecard is submitted.
postconditions_failure: Unscheduled candidates remain in interview stage with a pending task.

use_cases.name: Generate, approve and release an offer

stakeholders.interest: Receives a correct offer quickly.

preconditions: Pay range for grade and location is published.

postconditions_success: Signed offer exists and pre-boarding is started.
postconditions_failure: Offer is withdrawn or declined with reason; requisition stays open.

main_flow.action: Creates an offer for the selected candidate with grade, location, CTC and joining date.
Checks CTC against the pay range and flags offers above maximum.
Drafts the offer letter from the versioned template for recruiter review.

steps: Offer routes to an additional approval level with the excess shown.

exception_flows.condition: Candidate does not sign by the offer expiry date.

stakeholders.interest: No one works on a regulated task without a valid certification.
Gets enough notice to renew.

use_cases.trigger: A certification is recorded, nears expiry, or a shift assignment is attempted.
preconditions: Mandatory certifications per role or task are configured.
postconditions_success: Valid certifications allow assignment; expired ones block it.

main_flow.action: Uploads a certification with issue and expiry dates.
Verifies the certification.
Sends renewal reminders at 60, 30 and 7 days before expiry.
On expiry marks the certification expired.
Attempts to assign the employee to a task requiring the certification.
Blocks the assignment and states the expired certification.

steps: New certification is verified and replaces the old one.

exception_flows.condition: Urgent need to assign.
exception_flows.handling: Block stands; no override for mandatory certifications.

nfrs: Expiry evaluation runs daily before the first shift.

user_stories.want: assignments blocked when a mandatory certificate has expired

acceptance.given: E1018's forklift licence expired yesterday
acceptance.when: the supervisor assigns E1018 to forklift duty on shift A 08:00–20:00
acceptance.then: the assignment is blocked naming the expired licence

acceptance.given: E1018 uploads a renewed licence which is verified
acceptance.then: the assignment succeeds

user_stories.want: reminders before my licence expires

acceptance.given: my licence expires on 30 June
acceptance.then: I receive a 30-day reminder

acceptance.given: I renewed on 10 June
acceptance.then: no 7-day reminder is sent
